what: OA-13 (MED, Tier-1). The live-vs-replay parity check reads ok when its own controls could not run. Verified by the lane: scripts/ops/live_replay_parity.py:1197 counts a control as bad only on state=='fail', and findings() (~1309) only emits a failed control.
